versions.content: If FrNmPnEnabled is TRUE and the PNI bit in the NM PDU provided by FrNm_RxIndication() has the value 1, FrNm module shall process the Partial Networking Information of the NM-PDU as described in chapter 7.8.11.3 Aggregation of internal and external requested PNs and 7.8.11.4 Aggregation of external requested PNs
